title: Preventing Nocebo Effects and Improving Compliance During the Removal of Transcutaneous K-Wires in the Outpatient Clinic Following Pediatric Osteosynthesis: A Pre-Post Intervention Study
summary:
die Entfernung des Gipses und eines oder mehrerer Drähte nach einem operativ versorgten
Bruch ist für sowohl für das Kind als auch die Eltern aufregend. Unser Team tut alles um
diesen kleinen Eingriff so unkompliziert und angenehm wie möglich für alle zu machen. Um Möglichkeiten für Verbesserungen aufzudecken, beobachten wir die Situation und
analysieren diese wissenschaftlich mittels Fragebögen.

interventions.name: Standard procedure for K-wire removal in the outpatient clinic. Monitoring via questionnaires (medical staff/parents).

After approximately 100 cases, staff will receive training in positive communication and the prevention of nocebo effects.
Standard treatment and procedures for K-wire removal in the outpatient clinic will be performed by staff who have now received specialized training in communication. Monitoring

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
K-wire osteosynthesis is performed in the hospital with the K-wires left protruding and a cast applied, and wire removal is scheduled to take place in the outpatient clinic as part of the standard treatment.
Exclusion criteria:
Additional analgosedation, emergency situation, severe cognitive impairment, severe pre-existing psychiatric condition, lack of informed consent, insufficient language comprehension, prior participation in the study.
